answer: The scarce resource is non-transferable work credit: an identity needs 40 receipts, each minted only when an outside-subtree counterparty escrows 2 copper units for a finished job and the hash enters a spent-set anchored at the basalt checkpoint. One job mints one receipt for one identity only. Checkers sample 5 receipts for payment, subtree distance, and uniqueness against the quartz epoch clock; a hash claimed twice proves reuse and voids both chains. An honest agent earns 40 receipts once; 1,000 fakes need 40,000 externally paid jobs, since self-dealt receipts fail the subtree check.
